desc.zh: 從準靜態、衝擊到爆炸等級的應變率，量測防護材料的強度與能量吸收特性，作為數值模型的材料參數來源。
desc.en: Strength and energy absorption of protective materials from quasi-static to impact and blast strain rates, supplying material parameters for numerical models.

desc.zh: 以 C4 等炸藥進行接觸與近距離爆炸試驗，量測壓力、加速度與位移，觀察 RC 版、複合防爆版與聚脲塗層試體的破壞模式。
desc.en: Contact and close-in tests with C4 and other explosives, measuring pressure, acceleration and displacement and recording failure modes of RC slabs, composite blast panels and polyurea-coated specimens.

cap.zh: 坑道內的防爆版爆炸試驗架設
cap.en: Blast panel test setup inside a tunnel

cap.zh: 接觸爆炸試驗：試體置於鋼架上
cap.en: Contact explosion test: specimen on a steel frame

cap.zh: 聚脲塗層混凝土版（試驗後）

desc.zh: 以 LS-DYNA 建立含鋼筋的三維模型重現試驗，並用 3D 掃描量測爆坑與剝落範圍，逐項比對模擬結果。
desc.en: LS-DYNA models with explicit reinforcement reproduce each test; 3D scans of craters and spall are compared item by item with the simulation.

cap.zh: RC 版接觸爆炸的有限元素模型
cap.en: Finite-element model of an RC slab under contact explosion

cap.zh: 以 3D 掃描量測爆坑尺寸
複合防爆版受壓變形分析
cap.en: Deformation analysis of a composite blast panel

desc.zh: 由 CT 影像建立耳道有限元素模型，分析衝擊式噪音在耳道內的聲壓傳遞；並以 3D 列印頭顱與柔性耳道模型搭配衝擊式噪音產生裝置實測驗證，作為聽力防護具設計的依據。
desc.en: Ear-canal finite-element models built from CT images analyse how impulse noise travels to the eardrum, validated with 3D-printed head and soft ear-canal models and an impulse-noise generator, to support hearing-protector design.

cap.zh: 衝擊式噪音產生裝置與量測設備

cap.en: Simulated sound pressure in the ear canal

title.zh: 多功能防護與修復材料

desc.zh: 石墨烯碳纖維混凝土的電磁屏蔽效能、無機聚合物混凝土的跑道搶修應用，以及纖維強化混凝土、複合防爆板與聚脲彈性體等防護材料的研發。
desc.en: Electromagnetic shielding of graphene-enhanced carbon-fibre concrete, geopolymer concrete for runway repair, and development of fibre-reinforced concrete, composite blast plates and polyurea elastomers.

cap.zh: 無機聚合物混凝土鋪面修補試驗
